verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents a Business SMS Booster with a shared inbox so a team can manage customer texts together. It also has a call log for call history and integrations that plug the phone system into CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot. Nothing shows calls and texts threaded under one contact record, or team-visible notes, inside RingCentral itself, and CRM-side contact threading would be the CRM's feature rather than RingCentral's. missing for 10: unified per-contact thread of calls and texts, shared notes on contacts, team-wide visibility of contact history, independent or hands-on corroboration.
